senses.gloss: m. (גמל to wean, train) a pointed pole tied to the neck of a calf to prevent it from sucking (v. שִׁירְתּוּעַ), or a little yoke put on the calf for breaking it in.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:4:5">Y. Sabb. V, 7ᶜ</cite> top <he>אית תניין תני ג׳</he> some teachers read (Mish.
ib. V, 4) gimol (in place of gimon) in the sense of גמל in I Sam. I, 24; v. next w.
